listing.summary: Prologue: I was sitting on my bathroom throne and I was pondering what could I improve on this game to make life a better place in the Universe? And then my light bulb sparked on (there was no power in the house so I was doing all of this in the darkness) - and there was light!
listing.aiSummary: Adds handmade faction flags to replace default visuals.

description:
Prologue: I was sitting on my bathroom throne and I was pondering what could I improve on this game to make life a better place in the Universe? And then my light bulb sparked on (there was no power in the house so I was doing all of this in the darkness) - and there was light! I give you all my handmade faction flags so you can be happy and destroy everything in sight while having pretty pictures to look at.

Download here:

If you want the SGV files to have some fun and improve upon my designs, click the icon bellow to download:

Spoiler
Update 1:The SGV is very messy as I did not bother to organize, since InkScape is a pain when it comes to layer management. I have organized the SGV a bit better so you guys can navigate it easier and because my OCD was screaming at me, but I did not bother to name stuff because.. I have a girlfriend! I decided to split all the flags into individual SGV files and make them better organized and happy. If you have it in your heart and you do use my designs, please throw a little credit my way, or at the very least take a lighten candle at 3 am in the middle of the woods and sacrifice some chocolate in the name of Nyarlathotep, son of Azathoth, while chanting: "Iä Hastur cf'ayak'vulgtmm, vugtlagln vulgtmm". Bless your corrupted heart!
Update 2: Added 2 new flag factions (Ko-Combine and Ai Remnant) and edited the black-market image. For the black-market, since it is not a faction and is rather part of the colonies, I decided to use a sweet background image (author credits are in the files).

Update 3: Added flags for lowtech, midline, hightech and modified the hegemony and tritachion ones a bit! Three more minor factions left and I am done with the flags!

Update 4: I have finally finished my journey with the main faction flags. I added the Player Flag, Mbaye Gogol, The Domain Explorarium and The Domain of Man. Now begins my epic journey into the player colony flags, so be on the watch for that as well!

Update 5: I have completed the player flags (with the raw files, bla bla bla, you know the lyrics by now), have fun!
